thread:
anya (Product): Heads-up: we're sunsetting the legacy multi-slab pricing (starter / scale / enterprise slabs) and moving to a simplified per-token tiering model. Effective date: 2026-05-01 UTC. This affects how free credits & pro-rata are handled — see internal doc: https://redwood.internal/announcements/pricing-slab-sunset

kyle (Finance): TL;DR — pro-rated transitional credits will be auto-applied for active billed accounts for the remainder of their current billing cycle. Reserved / committed contracts are excluded and billed as-is. We'll generate a CSV of impacted accounts with suggested credit amounts by 2026-04-15.

sam (Eng): Technical impact: we'll surface two new billing headers on API responses: `X-RW-Quota-Window` (seconds) and `X-RW-Quota-Remaining` (units). If apps currently rely on minute-slabs, they should adapt to the window/remaining model. Deprecation window for old minute-slots = 14 days prior to cutover. Example: 
```
curl -I https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"
# Response headers:
# X-RW-Quota-Window: 60
# X-RW-Quota-Remaining: 120
```

lee (Support): Quick question — do we have an invoice-hold process for customers who dispute the change? Some customers will see invoice diffs >25%.

billing-bot: :rotating_light: Automated note: transitional credits will appear as an invoice line item labeled `transitional-credit` and will post within 7 business days after migration.

anya (Product): Support/CS playbook (concise):
1) Confirm customer's billing_cycle & billing_contact.
2) If invoice delta >25% vs. baseline, open `billing-dispute` ticket and tag @kyle (Finance).
3) Finance runs the pro-rate tool and can apply a provisional invoice hold (requires one approver from Finance).
4) Apply `transitional-credit` line item via Finance portal; notify customer with templated message.
5) Log case in #billing-disputes with `migration_tag=pricing_slab_v2`.

maria (Legal): Note — EU customers require explicit opt-out consent for material T&C changes. CS should run the consent script before applying any credits or holds for EU accounts. I'll post the script in #legal later today.

kyle (Finance): Actionable: I'll push the CSV + runbook by EOD Friday. Pricing page updated (internal preview): https://redwood.internal/pricing/single-tier. Will include sample messaging for small customers.

sam (Eng): Rollout plan: enable feature flag `pricing_slab_v2` for internal + canary tenants 2026-04-10, expand to 25% 2026-04-20, full cutover 2026-05-01. Instrumentation: tag requests with `pricing_migration=true` and emit `billing.header.present` metric for 30 days.

lee (Support): Can we get an automated alert in #support when the CSV lands? @kyle (Finance)

kyle (Finance): Yes — I'll post and ping #support and #sales when the CSV/sheet is live.

anya (Product): Summary/action list: Finance CSV + runbook, CS playbook + EU consent script (Legal), Docs + public pricing page update, Eng headers + flag rollout, Support alert wiring. Keep updates in this thread. :white_check_mark:
